title: Strong NP-Hardness and Approximation Algorithm for Weighted Tardiness with Release Dates and Identical Processing Times
summary: We study nonpreemptive scheduling on a single machine with release dates, due dates, positive job weights, and a common processing time. The objective is to minimize total weighted tardiness. Although closely related equal-processing-time problems admit polynomial-time algorithms, the complexity of this problem has remained open in the literature since 2010. We prove that its decision version is strongly NP-complete, even when every job can meet its due date if processed immediately upon release.
